subject: geopol.gulf
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Digital skills partnership agreement with the United Arab Emirates
what_would_settle_it: The signed memorandum or programme document behind the 1.5 million coding programme; the base carries one excerpt source naming the partner and one later restatement of the target that does not, with no signing date, value, delivery partner or enrolment figure

subject: data.statistics
name: The 2025 household survey report
what_would_settle_it: The statistics agency and regulator publication itself; the base holds only one outlet's account, so the sample design, provincial breakdowns and the rural and urban series behind the headline figures are that outlet's selection

subject: dpi.govtech
name: National electronic services portal
what_would_settle_it: The address and service inventory of a citizen-facing government services portal; the base holds two sector portals and nothing that aggregates services

subject: dpi.id
name: National digital identity enrolment statistics
what_would_settle_it: Any registrar-general or home affairs figure for cards issued or persons enrolled; the base establishes the announcement and the non-start, and holds no enrolment number at any date

subject: gov.policy
name: ICT Policy 2026-2030
what_would_settle_it: The policy document, or a gazette notice or ministry release announcing it; the base carries only the statistics agency's director-general naming it on 2026-07-20 as a framework the household survey will inform

subject: capacity.literacy
name: National digital literacy programme or measured literacy rate
what_would_settle_it: A statistics agency or regulator digital-skills module, or a named national literacy programme document; the base carries one source on this subject, a continental review, and literacy appears only as a barrier named by the central bank and as a service offered at digital centres

subject: infra.connect
name: Regulator's Q1 2026 sector performance report
what_would_settle_it: The regulator's own quarterly report; the base holds the Q4 2025 report in full but carries Q1 2026 only through a news account of a post-Cabinet briefing, so the 379 base stations, the 19,000 km backbone and the 57.28% traffic rise are all secondary and no per-operator table exists to check them against

subject: infra.cybersec
name: National Cybersecurity Strategy document
what_would_settle_it: The strategy itself; the base holds a one-minute report of the October 2025 launch and nothing else — no objectives, institutional arrangements, timetable or budget, and no subsequent milestone
